verdict.rationale: Bland documents per-agent development, staging and production environments. Pathway edits happen in drafts that do not affect live calls, and versions can be promoted to staging for testing before going live. The Testbed lets you replay and iterate on calls, and browser-based talk-testing is available. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox account or test API keys with isolated data, documentation that staging/test calls are kept separate from production data and telephony, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
